name: Orias
source:
Age: XX | LV 9 Reaper

Orias finds other people to be a pain in the ass, but his attitude really make him the pot calling the kettle black. Still, he considers himself to be just as reliable as the others.

He is particularly fastidious in all matters relating to the heroine, yet he will vehemently deny it and threaten violence when accused of favoring her. To combat this, he's extra rude to her.

LIKES
Peace. Being right. The opera. Combat. Wine tastings. Elegant things.

DISLIKES
When people are being stupid, having to clean up messes. When Xaphan and Seir are being too loud. Dumbasses
